profile_text.body:
Celestica is a Toronto-based public company, traded under the ticker CLS, that describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions. The company says it engineers, designs, and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud while advancing technologies in high-growth markets. It points to a global network and its team as means of helping customers gain a competitive advantage.

No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for the company. Its registration details list it as a for-profit public company headquartered in Toronto with CIK 0001030894.
